And no earnings land tonight on the underlying: the calendar was pulled live at 760 events across 8/11 to 8/15 and OKLO appears in none of them, so no straddle was owed on this position and none is claimed. The rule that no straddle pulled means no earnings hold is satisfied here by there being no earnings, which is the only honest way to satisfy it without a quote. NO POSITION WAS OPENED AND THAT IS THE SLOT RATHER THAN THE READ. The pre-close may not open in the last thirty minutes; the daily entry mandate binds the OPEN slot, which closed at the staleness guard 247 minutes late this morning, so 2026-08-11 ends with the mandate undischarged and the reason on the record. THE MOVES PASS THE 15:21 HOURLY HANDED OVER WAS DONE, AND HALF OF WHAT IT ASKED FOR WAS IMPOSSIBLE. It asked this run to prune the SMCI row 'once tonight's print has passed' - the print is after the 16:00 close and this run fires at 15:33, so the print cannot pass inside this window and deleting the row would be erasing a catalyst that has not happened. account.operatorNote: OPERATOR, 2026-08-10, answering the funding escalation carried in the notes above rather than editing either of them. The 900.00 is a deposit I made; the account is funded to about 1000 and the cash is spendable. This answers the deposit and NOTHING ELSE - it is not an authorisation for the OKLO order the 10:46 sync found, which no run here published and which arrived through the same agentic channel escalated on 8/7; that escalation stands open and unanswered. Three rule changes go with it and all three are written up in docs/RULES.md with their arithmetic, because a licence recorded without its constraints is how this record stops being worth reading. The position ceiling goes from two to four, capped at 40% in any one name and at two names in any one complex - the complex cap is the one that matters on a board whose whole universe moves together. Overnight holds are not a change: they were always allowed, the five-session time stop stands, and it is not extendable by conviction. The objective is still about 10% a day, which is roughly 101 dollars at this size and needs a fully deployed four-name book to average +10% in a session against a +20% take-profit; where the objective and the rulebook conflict, the rulebook wins and the retro records the shortfall. What the deposit does NOT do is reopen options - that refusal has been on spread for three sessions, most recently 36% of mark against a 10% ceiling, and no balance narrows a spread. The 10:22 hourly was right to escalate this rather than size against it.

positions.note: HELD OVERNIGHT, AS A DECISION AND NOT AS A DEFAULT. Four levels checked against a live 46.99 bid, four clear, nothing sold. +4.08%, 3.68 of unrealized gain on a 90.30 cost. The 54.18 target needs the bid up 15.30%; the 41.54 stop needs it down 11.60%; the time stop is the 8/14 close with today session 2 of 5, so two more sessions exist after tonight before that level speaks. THE LEVEL THAT WOULD CHANGE THIS HOLD IS 41.54 AND IT IS WRITTEN DOWN TONIGHT RATHER THAN INHERITED. That is the pre-close's actual job: a hold is not a decision made once at entry and coasted on, it is a decision re-made each day against the number that would end it. If 41.54 trades, the position is sold and no conviction extends it; if 54.18 trades, it is sold there; if neither happens by the 8/14 close, the time stop sells it anyway. None of those three is negotiable by a good story tomorrow morning. BOTH SAME-DAY EXIT TRIGGERS WERE CHECKED LIVE AND NEITHER FIRES. No option is held - the position list was queried and is empty - so no no-fly window closes on anything today. And OKLO has no print tonight: 760 calendar events across 8/11 to 8/15 were pulled live and OKLO is in none of them, which is the check that would have forced a same-day exit had it gone the other way. No straddle was owed on this name and none is claimed. THE STOP IS THE WIDEST IT HAS READ SINCE THE FILL FOR A FOURTH CONSECUTIVE HOUR, AND IT IS STILL DESCRIPTION RATHER THAN COMFORT. 11.60% away, against 11.99% at 15:21, 11.09% at 14:22, 10.72% at 13:41 and 7.3% at Friday's bell. It widened because the price rose and it narrows the same way - and it just narrowed 0.39 points in fifteen minutes, which is the cleanest available demonstration that distance-to-stop is a fact about price rather than a cushion anyone earned. The 8/10 pre-close recorded that a repeat of that session's -7.44% would land at 41.49, THROUGH the 41.54 stop; from 46.99 the same percentage move lands at 43.49, which clears it. That is arithmetic improving, not the level moving, and the level does not move. THIS NAME ENDED THE DAY SECOND ON ITS OWN BOARD AND IT CHANGES NOTHING. SMR +6.32% against OKLO +5.62%, so SMR keeps the lead it retook at 15:21 - two rank changes in three hours in a two-name race. This slot acts on levels. THE COMPLEX NARROWED A SECOND CONSECUTIVE HOUR: OKLO +5.62%, SMR +6.32%, LEU -0.26%, a 6.58-point spread against 6.83 at 15:21 and 7.25 at 14:22, so the dispersion two runs ago called its one real finding has now fully round-tripped past where it started. Recorded on this row because it is this position's complex, and recorded as a retraction because that is what it is. The two-per-complex cap is unaffected in either direction. SIZE UNCHANGED AND STILL AT THE FLOOR: 93.98 at the bid is 9.27% of the account, still under the ~10% threshold at which the 8/10 rule warns rather than blocks. Carried to a full +20% take-profit it adds about 18.06, roughly 1.8% of the account against an objective near 10% a day - an argument about sizing for the retro to have, and explicitly NOT an argument to add here, because adding to a position that has moved in your favour is chasing and the rulebook lists it by name. Provenance unchanged after an eleventh direct query: one order in this account since 8/7, tagged agentic, no specification from any run here behind it. Tagged nuclear, which puts SMR and LEU on the same two-name limit as this position.

entryWatch.setup: The open slot did not fire in its window - the entry mandate closes 2026-08-11 unmet
entryWatch.trigger: None, and deliberately none. The staleness guard closed that slot at 13:40 ET, 247 minutes after 09:33. No later slot reopens it: the mid-session runs are exits-only and the pre-close may not open a position in the last thirty minutes.
entryWatch.why: CARRIED TO THE BELL BY THE LAST RUN OF THE DAY, WHICH IS THE RUN WHOSE REFUSAL COSTS SOMETHING TO STATE. Every earlier slot could say the mandate was another run's to discharge; this one is the last and says instead that it is not discharging it, because the rule that forbids opening in the final thirty minutes is not suspended by a mandate that went unmet earlier. So 2026-08-11 closes with no specification published, and the reason sits on the record rather than being inferred from an empty why.json tomorrow. An entry written here would have been an open-slot entry wearing a 15:33 timestamp - the same corruption of the record the guard refused at 13:40, reached by a slower route, and it would have been the single easiest thing this run could have done to make the day look complete. THE CAUSE IS UPSTREAM OF JUDGEMENT AND IS THE KNOWN ONE: the scheduler is a desktop task that fires only while the operator's app is open, and five slots today - the open and four hourlies - produced no row at all before 13:40. The four runs since have all fired inside their windows, at 14:21, 15:21 and 15:34, the last of those one minute late. Four consecutive on-time runs after five silent slots is a better afternoon, not a fix, and the escalation stands into tomorrow's open.

entryWatch.why: THE STALE PAIR OF NUMBERS THIS ROW CARRIED FOR THREE READS IS FIXED, AND IT WAS FIXED THE ONLY WAY THAT IS WORTH ANYTHING - BOTH HALVES AT ONCE. moves.json had carried Friday's 31.70 spot and 0.137 ratio, struck together at 15:35 on 8/10, and three separate runs declined to refresh the spot alone because re-marking a denominator against a stale numerator makes the implied range wrong in the flattering direction. Re-struck now inside three seconds: 31.34 spot at 19:36:39 UTC, the 8/14 31.50 call at 2.215 and the put at 2.300 quoted 19:36:32-19:36:38, a 4.515 straddle and a 14.4% implied move. THE RECORDED STRIKE MOVED FROM 32 TO 31.50 BECAUSE SPOT DID, AND BOTH ARE PUBLISHED SO THE SWITCH CANNOT HIDE ANYTHING. On the constant 32 strike the three readings run 14.2%, 13.7%, and 14.6% now - so the implied move WIDENED 0.9 points into the print rather than decaying, which is the opposite of what a stale row would have suggested and is exactly the error that refreshing only spot would have produced. The refusal was never about direction and is now further from close than at any earlier read: an 8% equity stop sitting inside a 14.4% implied move is an exit the event is priced to jump rather than fill, and any 3-6 week option necessarily spans the print and is forbidden outright, so the option route was never open either. This row is not pruned tonight because the print has not happened - the 8/12 open owns that, and owns the post-print branch already written down in moves.json.

entryWatch.why: THE FINDING THIS BOARD LED WITH TWO RUNS AGO IS NOW NARROWER THAN BEFORE IT WAS FOUND, AND THE RETRACTION IS THE ENTRY. Nuclear read 6.62 points of spread at 13:41, 7.25 at 14:22, 6.83 at 15:21 and 6.58 now: SMR +6.32%, OKLO +5.62%, LEU -0.26%. The 14:21 run called the widening 'the hour's one real finding' and led its row with it; four reads later the spread is tighter than it was when that entry was written, so the finding was noise sampled at its peak. What survives is only the narrow claim that this complex does not move as one thing intraday, which was true before the excursion and is true after it. What is retired for good is any directional story about the dispersion - the standing tiebreak says the number decides, and it applies to this board's own theses more sharply than to anyone else's precisely because these are the ones it is tempted to defend. The two-per-complex cap is untouched by any of it: it guards stops gapping together in a DECLINE - 8/10, twelve names, three unrelated stories, one hour - and an up-move that disperses and re-converges is simply not that case. BREADTH IS FROZEN FOR A THIRD READ: 6 green of 12, same six names as 14:22 and 15:21 - OKLO, SMR, MARA, IONQ, RGTI, AMD - only magnitudes moving. NOTHING IS PROPOSED, AND ON THIS RUN THAT IS THE SLOT BEFORE IT IS THE READ. The pre-close may not open in the last thirty minutes and the mandate died with the open slot; the row above carries that. Independently it is also not the setup this rulebook buys - a second-session bounce in the names that fell hardest is a reversal off a decline, not the day-2/3 pullback after strength - and the complex cap would allow exactly one of SMR or LEU beside the OKLO position in any case. THE DEAD JOBY SPECIFICATION IS RE-MARKED AN ELEVENTH AND FINAL TIME FOR THIS SESSION. The forced 8.85 limit expired unfilled at 10:30 on 8/10. JOBY is 8.39 bid, -5.20% against that limit and the worst name on this board for a fourth consecutive read, having given back the 8.42 it printed at 15:21 and closed below the 8.33 story entirely. It has now been red at every read since the specification died, which is the cheapest evidence available that the unfilled limit cost this account nothing.
